---
# Negative control for the size guard. Not an example: this poster exists to
# FAIL the render, and it lives outside examples/ for that reason.
#
# `a3` is not a size the template knows — the named set is a0, a1, a2, and
# anything else has to be a "WxH" pair in inches. It used to fall through to
# 48x36 without a word, so a poster asked for at A3 came back full size and
# looking deliberate. Capital "36X24" landed in the same hole. A poster is
# printed once, so a name the template cannot resolve has to stop the render.
title: "Size guard fixture"
format:
  sciposter-typst:
    poster:
      size: a3
      columns: 1
---

Body.
